plugin.name: GPT-SoVITS
plugin.description: Speech from a reference voice on your local GPT-SoVITS server.
plugin.longDescription: Connect an existing GPT-SoVITS api_v2.py server at 127.0.0.1:9880. Configure a reference audio path, its exact transcript and language, then generate WAV speech with the server’s loaded model. This plugin does not install models, upload files or change the server’s weights. Each job keeps its reference settings. Saved results can be recovered; a response lost before it was saved cannot be queried from the server.
model.name: GPT-SoVITS
config.referencePath.title: Reference audio path
config.referencePath.description: Absolute path on the GPT-SoVITS server, for example /Users/me/voices/reference.wav. The file is not uploaded.
config.referenceText.title: Reference transcript
config.referenceText.description: The words spoken in the reference audio. Required for compatibility with V3/V4/V5.
config.referenceLanguage.title: Reference language
config.referenceLanguage.description: Language spoken in the reference audio: zh (Chinese), en (English) or ja (Japanese).
config.textLanguage.title: Default text language
config.textLanguage.description: auto detects the text language; explicit request languages override this setting.
